$comment: Open questions, gaps, conflicts, assumptions, risks, approvals and known defects. Every open item names the evidence that would resolve it. An open 'conflict' blocks any task it lists in 'blocks'; it may never be treated as settled.

records.title: master (441d772) fails CI on an intermittent ECONNRESET in test/identity-modes.js
records.statement: The last CI run that executed on master (run 38665829638, 2026-10-15, head 441d772 — the base of PR #4) failed in `npm test` on Node 22: test/identity-modes.js:33 `fetch failed … read ECONNRESET`; the other jobs were cancelled by fail-fast. The same class of flake is REVIEW.md finding T1, and a commit on the unmerged branch feat/production-readiness says it fixes the server keep-alive timeout that causes it (AMD-0022). Pre-existing; locally the full suite passed on 441d772 and on every commit of PR #4 except the two regressions recorded in HO-CTX-0001-001/002.
evidence: commit message on feat/production-readiness (run 32 head 4598780) describing the keep-alive fix
records.evidenceNeeded: Land the keep-alive fix on master (or confirm it fixes this), then observe a green CI run on master.

records.title: Seal manifest hashes a file that does not exist
records.statement: lib/canonical.js:104 lists 'UCOS-Zero-Hardcoding-Constitution.md' in INPUT_FILES, but the repository file is 'UCRS-Zero-Hardcoding-Constitution.md' (which lib/ucos.js:72 parses). The seal manifest records the listed file as missing, so an edit to the real UCRS constitution does not drift the seal. Pre-existing; tracked separately from the continuity work.
evidence: `npm run registry` reports 'sources 28 files' including the missing entry (observed 2026-10-22)
records.evidenceNeeded: Confirm UCRS-Zero-Hardcoding-Constitution.md is the intended input, correct INPUT_FILES, re-run `npm run registry` and `node test/registry-gate.js`.

records.title: GitHub Actions jobs never start: CI cannot produce evidence
records.statement: Every CI run in the repository since 2026-10-19 fails in about 4 seconds with no runner assigned (runner_id 0, no steps executed, log download HTTP 404). That covers the eight runs on PR #3 (feat/production-readiness) and run 39740943856 on PR #4 (e1a3613, all three Node jobs). The last run that executed was on 2026-10-15. This happens before any repository code runs, so it is an account- or Actions-level condition, not a failure of the code under test. Not caused by the context continuity work.
evidence: GitHub API list_workflow_runs / get_workflow_job for run 39740943856, jobs 119697727787, 119697728280, 119697728347 (observed 2026-10-22)
runs 31–37 on PR #3 show the same ~4 s failure
records.evidenceNeeded: The repository owner checks the Actions settings and billing/spending limits for echelonxventures-Projects, then re-runs CI on PR #4.

records.title: Eleven projected artifacts share another artifact's content block
records.statement: _registry/content-map.json maps each constitution UCOS-CON-000001…010 to the same content key as a core-domain artifact (e.g. CON-000001 Constitutional Foundation and IDN-000001 Identity Architecture both → core/IDN; CON-000007 Privacy Constitution → core/AUT, the Authority Architecture block), and UCOS-CLS-000001 shares ext/SEM with UCOS-SEM-000001. The projections are 83–91% identical by word-shingle Jaccard, and some titles do not match the content they project. Pre-existing; found by context:hygiene on 2026-10-22.
records.evidenceNeeded: Owner decides whether each constitution needs its own content block in _registry/content-*.json (then re-project and audit) or whether the sharing is intended (then record that as a decision).

records.title: Status of the Postgres-cutover blockers is unknown
records.statement: RESOLVED by code inspection. The 2026-09-17 review's three Postgres blockers are handled in the translator: INSERT OR REPLACE → ON CONFLICT … DO UPDATE (lib/sql.js:64–71), INSERT OR IGNORE → ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING (lib/sql.js:58–60, 109), scalar MAX(a,b) → GREATEST (lib/sql.js:57); REVIEW.md (2026-10-12) S0001 records all of H1–H8 and M1–M6 as closed. Residual, not a defect of this record: no live Postgres was exercised in this session, and README S0003 still describes the request-path cutover as a runbook step that needs a live Postgres.
records.evidenceNeeded: A run against a real Postgres, or code inspection of lib/sql.js translation for the three constructs.

records.title: 'Zero runtime dependencies' vs declared npm dependencies — resolved: no real conflict
records.statement: RESOLVED. README S0001 states the default boot is dependency-free and that bull/ioredis (the optional Redis queue, LX_QUEUE=redis) and prom-client are the only npm runtime packages, loaded only when configured. The code matches: lib/queue.js:51 requires bull and lib/metrics.js:121 requires prom-client, each lazily. The issue as originally opened rested on an incorrect observation by this agent (the grep output that would have shown those requires was truncated by `| head`, and 'no matches' was recorded). The only stale statement is MEMORY.md S0002's 'zero runtime dependencies', which is historical evidence, not authority.
evidence: lib/queue.js:51 require("bull"), lib/metrics.js:121 require("prom-client") — grep observed 2026-10-22 (TASK-CTX-0004)
correction of the earlier observation recorded in state fact F-005
records.evidenceNeeded: Owner decides whether the three packages are vestigial (remove) or intended (correct the documentation).
